YouTubie is a high-performance video discovery and download prototype for Android. Built with a modern tech stack — Kotlin, Coroutines, Dagger Hilt, Retrofit, and WorkManager — it demonstrates a modular architecture capable of handling multi-threaded data transfers and delivering a consistent, immersive user experience.

Paste the link you copied in the field and then press the "Search" button. Be aware that only YouTube videos can be searched containing the "youtu.be" or "youtube.com" and not YouTube shorts.
While searching, do not close the application nor the internet connection. Once the search is successful, you can view the video\'s data on your screen.
Click the "Audio" or "Video" button to download the video in your preferred format in HD quality.
After downloading anything, it will show in the download history screen. Swipe left from the homepage to view the history.
Click the "Search another video" button to clear your current search and start again. Your current search will not be saved.
To successfully download YouTube videos you need to have a stable internet connection and you need to have granted the necessary storage permissions.

Some videos are not downloadable due to YouTube restrictions on copyrighted material such as VEVO videos. To be able to download such VEVO songs, try searching for:
1. Lyrics-only videos
2. Same songs uploaded by non-VEVO channels
3. Automatically generated topics from YouTube
If you face a "Could not search for video" error then try your luck some time later. Sometimes its a server-wise problem and not the video\'s or YouTube\'s fault.
Long-clicking the thumbnail of your searched YouTube video will let you download it in png format and HD quality.
